subject: Handoff cadence and final close play for SOC 2 / DPA checkpoints
messages:
From: Lara Chen <lara.chen@firstcapital.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@firstcapital.com
Date: Sun, 10 Jun 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff cadence and final close play for SOC 2 / DPA checkpoints

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the demo last week — we had a productive internal sync and want to line up a clear handoff cadence so we can finish procurement by end of June. To close: we need (1) SOC 2 Type II evidence summary, (2) SIG/CAIQ responses prioritized to our top 12 control areas (we can share the list), (3) an agreed DPA with retention window spelled out for backups and logs, and (4) an explicit acceptance path in the MAP that names owners and sign-off gates.

Can you share a short, dated MAP that lays out who does what by when, and confirm whether Redwood can provide an escrow of audit logs for review during our evaluation window? Also please attach any SOC 2 summary and the latest DPA draft you expect us to review.

We prefer a single tracked document and a quick review meeting the week of Jun 18. Tom Whitaker (security) will own the review from our side.

Thanks,
Lara

--
Lara Chen
Senior Manager, Procurement
First Capital Bank
l.chen@firstcapital.com

(Attachment: none — we will send the SIG priority list after you confirm cadence)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Lara Chen <lara.chen@firstcapital.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff cadence and final close play for SOC 2 / DPA checkpoints

Hi Lara — thanks for the clear list. Attaching a concise MAP and the items you requested for visibility: a one-page SOC 2 summary, our CAIQ/SIG answers workbook (highlighted rows are our top 12), and a redline DPA for your team.

High-level MAP (proposed cadence):
- 2028-06-12: Redwood posts CAIQ answers + SOC2 summary (done; attached). Owner: Sofia
- 2028-06-14: FCB sends prioritized SIG items + security questions. Owner: Tom Whitaker (FCB)
- 2028-06-18: Technical review meeting (sandbox walk-through + SIG Q&A). Owner: Marcus (Redwood) & Tom (FCB)
- 2028-06-20: Redwood delivers requested logs/export sample and legal incorporates comments. Owner: Operations / Legal
- 2028-06-22: Final DPA countersign target (procurement/legal alignment)
- 2028-07-01: Canary production start / SLA baseline established (post-signature)

What I want to call out: we can provide a time-limited logs export (redacted) and sandbox access for your security team to validate telemetry and retention behavior. Our SOC 2 summary highlights the last external audit period and the scope (in attachments). If you prefer, we can add one more gate for a short SRE performance check before the canary.

Next steps: I suggest a 45-minute technical + legal kickoff on Jun 18 at 10:00 AM ET. Marcus will run the tech portion; Kimberly will handle DPA and contract questions. Please confirm attendees and Tom's availability.

Attachments:
- redwood-soc2-summary-2028.pdf (SOC 2 summary, 2 pages)
- redwood-sig-answers-2028.xlsx (CAIQ/SIG answers, highlighted rows)
- DPA-draft-FCB-redline.docx (initial redline)

Best,
Sofia

--
Sofia Ivanova
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
(Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary-2028.pdf; redwood-sig-answers-2028.xlsx; DPA-draft-FCB-redline.docx)

From: Tom Whitaker <tom.whitaker@firstcapital.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Lara Chen <lara.chen@firstcapital.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff cadence and final close play for SOC 2 / DPA checkpoints

Sofia — thanks, received. A few clarifications from security:
- We will send a prioritized SIG list by EOD Jun 13 (format: spreadsheet, column for "critical/important/optional").
- We need an explicit retention table in the DPA that covers: inference logs (7 days), debug traces (30 days), backups (365 days), and a separate tier for EU residency exports. Can Redwood confirm EU-region data residency for any test exports?
- Regarding the logs export: we prefer hashed identifiers and a documented transform to ensure no PII in the sample. Can Marcus own that artifact?

Also copying procurement; procurement will need a single doc with milestone sign-offs so their counsel can route the countersign.

Tom
Tom Whitaker
Senior InfoSec Engineer
First Capital Bank
(tom.whitaker@firstcapital.com)

(Attachment: FCB-SIG-priority-list.xlsx — will follow separately)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Tom Whitaker <tom.whitaker@firstcapital.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Lara Chen <lara.chen@firstcapital.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff cadence and final close play for SOC 2 / DPA checkpoints

Tom / team — heads up on a few technical points so we can align the MAP acceptance artifacts:
1) EU residency: sandbox exports can be staged in our EU region (Frankfurt) for test export; production residency will follow the DPA and the region selected at deployment.
2) Retention table: we'll include the four buckets you asked for and add an "audit snapshot" column for log hashes. Expect an updated DPA redline by Jun 20 (Legal + Compliance).
3) Logs export: we will provide a hashed sample with the transform documented. I'll own delivery and will post the artifact to the MAP folder.

I've also created a short runbook that describes the acceptance checks we typically require: SIG triage, SOC 2 checklist pass, DPA in place, sandbox test pass, and a short SRE smoke test. Link here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbcDef-MAP-FCB-2028 (access granted to l.chen & t.whitaker).

I'll be online for the Jun 18 meeting and will demo the sandbox retention toggles.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

(Attachment: none; will upload logs-export-sample to the MAP folder)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Lara Chen <lara.chen@firstcapital.com>, Tom Whitaker <tom.whitaker@firstcapital.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff cadence and final close play for SOC 2 / DPA checkpoints

Thanks everyone — quick confirmations before the Jun 18 kickoff:
- Meeting: Jun 18, 10:00 AM ET (45 min) — calendar invite sent.
- Deliverables before meeting: FCB SIG priority list (Tom) by Jun 13 EOD, Redwood will surface logs-export-sample and updated DPA redline by Jun 20.
- Acceptance gates in the MAP: Security sign-off (Tom) -> Legal countersign (Procurement) -> SRE smoke test (Marcus) -> Business sign-off (Lara). We'll record acceptance in the HubSpot record: HubSpot:hs_record_FCB_0421.

If everyone signs off on the cadence I'll lock the MAP and set the canary target to Jul 1. If anything changes we'll treat the Jun 22 DPA countersign as the hard stop for procurement.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — see you on Jun 18.

Best,
Sofia

--
